(define largest2
  (lambda (L)
    (if (null? (cdr L))
        (car L)
        (let ((largestval (largest2 (cdr L))))
          (if (>= (car L) largestval)
              (car L)
              largestval)))))
description: You can follow how let preserves the maximum of the list tail.

steps.description: largest2 returns the first element when the rest of L is empty. You use this one-element list as the stopping case.
The recursive call finds the largest value in the cdr. You bind its result to largestval for use in the body.

steps.answer: No. It returns the saved largestval directly.
